newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press digest - France - Le Monde April 2.
newsitem.headline: Press digest - France - Le Monde April 2.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Junior doctors to join hospital staff in demonstrations against Prime Minister Alain Juppe's plans to tighten government controls on health spending.
-- Britain's GEC Plc has declared itself a candidate for the acquisition of the state's 58-percent stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.

-- French state's help to state-owned companies as part of restructuring plans amounted to a total of some 190 billion francs since 1992. European Commission calls for further asset sales for recapitalised companies, to protect their competitors.
-- Suez board approves proposed merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux, Suez posts a profit of 843 million francs for 1996.
-- Cigarette manufacturers seek to reverse decline in consumption, notably through price cuts which may jeopardise state tax revenues.
